title: Experiments: the topics of the Daisy reference
intro: The second tab lists the 107 topics of the Daisy reference manual in three parts. A topic shows its models, the parameters that Daisy accepts for experiments and the related experiments. The size of the experiment is set before loading.

marks.d: How many values of each parameter are tested.
Every combination, one thing at a time, or paired.
Scroll the list; a star marks a topic that has its own experiments.
Moves through the topics in order.
Adds the experiment to my experiments.
Loads the experiment for checking and running.
